mapper.select: SELECT em.emp_id, em.emp_name, em.emp_comp_mail, em.stay_expiration_date, mm.mail_idx, mm.issue_to_date FROM emp_mgt as em LEFT JOIN mail_mgt AS mm ON em.emp_id = mm.emp_id AND mm.job_id = 'KSBAT_PT001' AND mm.logical_del_flg = false WHERE em.stay_expiration_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '93 days' AND em.logical_del_flg = false AND em.resign_flg = false AND (mm.mail_idx IS NULL OR (mm.issue_flg = true AND mm.issue_to_date >= CURRENT_DATE)) ORDER BY em.emp_id
mapper.insert:
